**Lines:** 46, 104, 116, 140-144, 156, 166-170

## Fixed Code

```go
func (c *Cache) Set(key string, value interface{}) {
    c.mu.Lock()
    defer c.mu.Unlock()
    c.data[key] = &CacheEntry{
        Value:     value,
        ExpiresAt: time.Now().Add(c.ttl),
    }
}

func (c *Cache) cleanup() {
    c.mu.Lock()
    defer c.mu.Unlock()
    
    now := time.Now()
    for key, entry := range c.data {
        if now.After(entry.ExpiresAt) && !entry.Loading {
            delete(c.data, key)
        }
    }
}

func (c *Cache) GetMulti(ctx context.Context, keys []string) map[string]interface{} {
    var wg sync.WaitGroup
    var mu sync.Mutex
    results := make(map[string]interface{})

    for _, key := range keys {
        wg.Add(1)
        go func(k string) {
            defer wg.Done()
            value, err := c.Get(ctx, k)
            if err == nil {
                mu.Lock()
                results[k] = value
                mu.Unlock()
            }
        }(key)
    }
    wg.Wait()
    return results
}

// Use atomic operations for stats
type Stats struct {
    Hits       atomic.Int64
    Misses     atomic.Int64
    LoadErrors atomic.Int64
}

// In Get(): c.stats.Hits.Add(1)
```

For `waitForLoad`, use `sync.Cond` instead of busy-wait. For `LoadOrStore` and `Refresh`, add mutex protection.
